adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent, `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` uses `externalCalendarId` in the `.find(...)` predicate precisely in the branch where `externalCalendarId` is falsy. That makes the lookup effectively never succeed (unless a destination calendar has an empty/undefined externalId), so it will fail to select a destination calendar when `externalCalendarId` is not provided and likely fall back to a default elsewhere. The finding’s “unreachable” wording is slightly off (the branch is reachable), but the logic is still a real defect.
